title: Soter: Analytical Tensor-Architecture Modeling and Automatic Tensor Program Tuning for Spatial Accelerators
problem: Existing auto-tuning compilers for spatial accelerators generate numerous invalid and inefficient tensor programs or make inaccurate evaluations of incomplete programs, resulting in sub-optimal performance.
motivation: Spatial accelerators are specialized hardware for tensor computations, but efficiently mapping tensor programs to these accelerators requires auto-tuning compilers that explore valid design spaces with accurate evaluation.
method: Soter uses a mathematical model to identify which program configurations will work on spatial accelerators and filter out inefficient ones, creating a high-quality set of options. An automatic tuning system then explores only these valid configurations to find the best one. The mathematical model improves as the tuner explores, continuously refining which configurations are worth evaluating.
key_novelty: A mathematical model filters program configurations before an automatic tuner explores them, ensuring only valid, complete programs are evaluated.
contributions: Analytical model to generate high-quality program design spaces excluding invalid and inefficient programs
Automatic program tuner for efficient space exploration without evaluating incomplete programs
Coordination mechanism between model and tuner to iteratively improve design space quality
Achieves 2.1× to 3.5× speedup over state-of-the-art tensor compilers with improved scalability
primary_theme: Analytical tensor-architecture modeling for program tuning
